fields.title: Polka: demo worked, production didn't
fields.summary: 94% correct answers in pilot, 71% after rolling out to 900 stores.
fields.decisionPrompt: What do we do? Name the price of your solution.
fields.brief/role: You are the PM for Polka.
fields.brief/company: Polka is a fictional grocery delivery service from local stores: 900 partner stores, a buyer app, and a partner dashboard.
fields.brief/context: You are the PM for Polka. The "ask about a product" feature in a three-store pilot yielded 94% correct answers. After rolling out to all 900 — 71%.
fields.brief/objective: Restore answer quality on the expanded corpus and figure out how to measure it going forward.
fields.brief/constraints: 71% quality and growing marks. Five weeks for a full solution.
fields.brief/task: Decide what you do and name how you will measure the result.
fields.learnTakeaway/title: RAG quality drops in retrieval, not in the model
fields.learnTakeaway/body: When the knowledge base grows, answers deteriorate not because the model got dumber: the needed document stops making it into the context. You need to look at retrieval logs — what came in as input and whether the right thing was there. And alongside the fix, you always rebuild the eval set: built on a small corpus, it stops measuring what is actually happening.
fields.evidenceCards/0/content: Corpus grew from 1,200 products to 40 thousand. Descriptions from 60 different suppliers of varying quality were added.
fields.evidenceCards/1/content: In 24% of cases, the necessary document did not make it into the context at all. In 18%, it made it in along with 7 irrelevant ones.
fields.evidenceCards/2/content: Pure vector, top-8, no filters, no re-ranking.
fields.evidenceCards/3/content: Chunking. Everything is cut uniformly into 500-character chunks.
fields.decisionOptions/0/description: Stronger model. 2 days, twice as expensive.
fields.decisionOptions/0/consequence: does not affect the 24% of cases where the required info is missing from context. Might help slightly with the 18% noise. Does not address the core problem.
fields.decisionOptions/1/description: Store filter plus re-ranking. One and a half weeks.
fields.decisionOptions/1/consequence: filter reduces the corpus from 40 thousand to 3–6 thousand per query — directly hits the 24%. Re-ranking hits the 18% noise. The most targeted measures.
fields.decisionOptions/2/description: Hybrid search plus structure-based chunking. Three weeks.
fields.decisionOptions/2/consequence: solves brand issues and mid-ingredient splits. Correct in substance, takes longer.
fields.decisionOptions/3/label: Everything, plus rebuild the eval set on new data
fields.decisionOptions/3/description: Everything, plus rebuild the eval set on new data. Five weeks.
fields.decisionOptions/3/consequence: Full solution: filter and re-ranking address measured causes, hybrid search and structure chunking fix brand and split-ingredient problems, and the rebuilt eval set describes reality again. Cost — five weeks with 71% quality and a growing number of "inaccurate" marks: two-thirds of the effect was available in a week and a half.
fields.rubric/remediation/0/gap: Does not break down RAG step by step
fields.rubric/remediation/1/gap: Unaware of degradation with corpus growth
fields.rubric/remediation/2/gap: Does not keep the evaluation set up to date
fields.rubric/remediation/3/gap: Does not measure what actually enters the context before the response
